ranges.role: Primary home, Moretti family life, Blackthorn Security Company, Nighthawk training, first four Seer-pathway stages of growth and the Tingen climax.
Late-story return to old places as Klein reinforces humanity and self-awareness.
Sherlock Moriarty detective era, early Tarot expansion, Lanevus revenge, Rosago, Sharron and Maric, and Magician-to-Faceless development.
Dwayne Dantès era, high-society infiltration, Bizarro Sorcerer development, Great Smog investigation and George III conspiracy.
Post-war return after the Seven Lights revelation, used to reconnect with ordinary human society.
Primary Gehrman Sparrow adventurer era, pirate hunting, Sea God inheritance, Creeping Hunger use, Marionettist advancement and extensive real-world acting.
Rorsted becomes the center of Sea God believers and one of Klein's long-term anchor communities.

name: Sefirah Castle / the world above the gray fog

ranges.role: Klein's persistent gray-fog domain: Tarot gatherings, divination enhancement, item storage, prayer responses, high-sequence authority and the final contest for the Lord of the Mysteries position.
The domain is explicitly understood and named as Sefirah Castle as Klein's knowledge and control deepen.
Amon captivity and escape, Chernobyl/Earth revelation, City of Silver operations, Dark Angel/Sasrir history, and the road to Miracle Invoker.
Klein's marionette town and Attendant of Mysteries ritual project; later the site of Zaratul's ambush and Adam's hidden capture arrangement.
Klein begins accommodation of The Fool's Uniqueness through the Antigonus plan and completes the Sequence 0 apotheosis conflict.
